item.title: Marketing Automation in the Services Sector with Combined Artificial Intelligence
item.description: The article discusses the modeling of artificial intelligence to address the issue of predicting future demand in the service sector (hairdressing, massages, exercise, doctors, physiotherapists, etc.). Future demand is examined on a weekly granularity and may exhibit fluctuations, particularly declines.
